loopback_replay.old_runtime_discovery: one source at a time using the pre-migration Python AsyncClient
loopback_replay.request_protocol: HTTP GET; 4 source metadata requests in each cold/warm discovery and 4 artifact requests in batch acquisition per runtime and pair

measurement_limitations.host_page_cache: Cold means the first operation in a fresh helper process; the host filesystem/page cache is not flushed.
measurement_limitations.provider_network: Source-delay replay uses an explicit 127.0.0.1 HTTP fixture and does not measure public-provider RTT or service load.
measurement_limitations.sampling: Process-tree RSS and temporary-file peaks are sampled; short-lived descendants or files may fall between samples.

cat_first_frame.completion_event: the PTY reader has received every ANSI cell in the complete preview frame
cat_first_frame.limitation: measures renderer output delivery to a PTY, not terminal-emulator paint or physical display latency
cat_first_frame.pixel_validation: parse foreground/background RGB and block glyph for every cell; paired semantic fingerprints must match for the same input SHA-256

methodology.direct_child_peak_rss: wait4 ru_maxrss for the directly launched CLI process
methodology.network: RADIUST_RUNTIME__ALLOW_NETWORK=false for every child; no public network is requested
methodology.pair_order: alternates Python/native first on each repetition
methodology.process_tree_peak_rss: sampled ps RSS sum; if a short-lived CLI exits before observation, fall back to wait4 direct-child peak and label the sample
methodology.temporary_bytes: maximum observed regular-file bytes beneath each isolated runtime root

cat_file.title: local cat --file ANSI first frame on an 80x24 PTY
